verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents a 'Link external directory' option that picks a folder or Document Package via the Files app, which covers folders in other apps' sandboxes. It also documents dragging files in from other apps, exposing its own repositories to third-party apps through the document picker and file browser, and moving files via WebDAV and Shortcuts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of linking repositories in other apps' sandboxes, and deeper documentation of how linked external directories behave (permissions, persistence, sync).
